evidence_projection: Only explicitly supplied one-step node aliases; original endpoints and mapping bases retained; no identities inferred and no solution scores changed.
interpretation: No exact-mapped measured lipid has an eligible direct regulatory edge in the full PKN. Any selected routes with a later chemical-to-protein transition nominate indirect metabolic availability hypotheses, not direct signaling lipids or confirmed biochemical precursors.
limitations: A directed signed route is a prior-knowledge hypothesis, not evidence of causality, flux or biochemical feasibility in hepatocytes.
Reaction instances encode substrate participation, product formation and catalyst availability; they do not implement mass balance or enzyme kinetics.
The actual regulatory chemical may be an unmeasured metabolite or co-product; its abundance or availability is not independently established.
Shortest-route classifications do not summarize every alternative walk through the solution.
Lipid weights and RNA-derived TF activities are observational measurements on different scales; MOON scores are inferred statistics.
representative_path_policy: One shortest path per reachable input pair; greatest minimum absolute inferred MOON score; deterministic signed-edge tie breaking in the shortest-path DAG. Level-zero observed TF activities excluded from score bottleneck. Not all alternative routes are enumerated.
